notes.title: The rhythm dance of the tuner and the spirit
notes.content:
Dance HIME: Rhythm And Extinction is set in a SINGULARITY world created by four magic instruments. As a "tuner", you are summoned by resonating with the sacred echo of the artifact, and the elves use the artifact infinite drum to successfully summon you to Siguroldi. In fact, the world of Sigordi at this time is in a state of rest, and the area you are in is the "singularity field" created by the instrument of the void.


The singularity fields

This is a multifaceted, subspacetime realm that exists and does not exist. The elves use their own energy as the base of balance in the realm, sealing the chaotic energy of time and chord in different planes of the past, present and future. It is also the place where the temperers tune. The giant broken clock also suggests that time stands still here. Of course, the field is not 100% stable, and certain combinations in tuning can affect the appearance of the field as a whole.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550481/b724331e528655d9f996391ff77ca245dc7b4625.png[/img]

When the string field

In tuning, the permutations of the inspiration stones create a smokeball, and five of the same stone permutations create a rainbow orb. The rainbow sphere passively absorbs very small amounts of synchrony energy. So, when the two rainbow spheres combine their missions, there is a huge impact on the singularity field, which allows the tuner to enter another sub-plane field, the time string field. Everything here is between the real and the unreal, dreamlike, but also very unstable, so when you interrupt rhythm, you are forced to move out of the realm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550481/0f52d92d664e6e9d7beb8103da7914e602319499.png[/img]

Law of the Lord stage

When the rhythm is completed, the spirits convert the rhythm into the energy of the healing chord, a process called the prayer dance. The prayer dance directly in the singularity realm is affected by the chaos energy that has not yet been repaired, so the elves need to pray on a specific law stage. The player as the rhythm tuner can enter the stage, however, in order to ensure 100% success of the dance, the rhythm tuner can only watch, not contact with the girl.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550481/e7499fc1316d7cfd115d6123907ce297b9174735.png[/img]

notes.title: Harmony fairy mystic maiden Hemami
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550481/6a8f3c5471174019c24f9450809026df4c057aeb.jpg[/img]
Singularity is a Singularity in which humans and "elves" coexist. There are seven pillars of creation in this world. Generally, they are distinguished by symbolic "colors", namely red, blue, green, yellow, purple, orange and pink. Among them, red, blue and green are the original elves, which have never died at the beginning of their birth.
In order to prevent the time energy from running wild, the three prototypal elves seal the chaotic energy in the past, present and future respectively through the magic of the trinity. This gives rise to three plane domains.
Hemami is the original spirit of harmony and the original spirit of blue pillar, maintaining the balance of the future plane realm with the law of harmony. When the player fixes the [present] time string, he is sucked into the unknown [future] by the string sound of Himami.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550481/2c5dd6ef24ab7d0200914c9c331b3893f7ad633a.jpg[/img]
Original name: Himanisiarty Ilnayaro
Nickname: Hemami
Spirit Properties: Harmony Spirit, the original Spirit of Harmony
Height: 170 cm
Weight: unknown
CUP: F

Pupil: purple

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550481/1e5d048e969215300d3a1e691e534c8ce60b75c7.jpg[/img]
Hemami is the only elf who can see the color of the spirit. Of all the creatures she had seen over thousands of years, the human soul was the most fickle. Hemami has seen brilliant golden souls turn to a dull gray in war, and confused black souls turn to pure white in the presence of lovers. The human friends she once trusted would betray her, and the people she thought were fallen souls would come to her rescue at critical moments.
She could not understand human beings, but also very curious about the reason for the discoloration of human souls, gradually she began to intentionally or unintentionally create some events, so as to observe the transformation of human souls after the event. On the other hand, she didn't like changing souls very much, so she was very fond of cats, because all cats are her favorite color of turquoise, and will not change until death."
In the game, Anime doesn't give directions like the other two elves, preferring to let the tuner do what he or she wants. There is no absolute balance in the realm of the future, so the energy of the time string becomes more ethereal and disordered. Whether you trivialize it or try to control it, you risk losing control [of the future]. Hemami only needs the rhythm tuner to create the divine law of the future, for the rest she does not care. She may lend you a helping hand at a crucial moment or give you a push from behind. Of course, these are just two of countless possibilities. Who knows what will happen

Wendy has a gentle personality. She doesn't like noisy places. She likes to dance to beautiful music in the peach blossom forest. As the original green pillar spirit who never died, she has witnessed the beauty and darkness of humanity, but still has a love for humanity. Perhaps it was a girl named Peach who made Wendy recognize the beauty of the original human being.

It must have been thousands of years ago. Even Wendy can't remember the exact time. She only remembered that it was a sunny afternoon, in the peach forest of petals dancing "picked up" a human little girl - peach, was "lai" on the rear of its growth. They experienced together purple column ancestor elf out of control things. In order to prevent the collapse of the world, tao severs each other's contract, sacrifice spirit plays the infinite drum, one of the sacred objects, and then disappears. Wendy has been waiting for the reincarnation of the peach for thousands of years.

In the game, Wendy will gently guide the temperer to complete the [present] divine law. Of course, the [present] challenge will be more difficult than the [past] challenge, but the [past] experience will also make you more comfortable with the [present] challenge. The advice to Wendy is: only the present is real. Make sure you grasp the present and respond to the good in order to create the divine law of the present.
